marketing_description: The EDGE Safety Glass XB11PCVS is part of the Edge Series and features a photochromic lens made of polycarbonate, offering benefits such as anti-fog coating, scratch-resistant coating, impact-resistant, UV protection, and anti-glare coating. This unisex product measures 33-7/16 in H x 23-7/8 in W x 22-5/8 in D. The photochromic lenses provide a convenient solution for varying light conditions.
